plugins.description: Claude Code plugin for the SpinDoctor 3.1.2 quantum-circuit SIMULATOR: CLI-first slash commands (run, script, preset, folder, report, functions, theory), a helper agent and a local MCP server; 1-298 logical qubits, 241 presets, TXT/PDF/JSON/CSV reports.
